# Using AI Features for Documents

Learn how to use AI features in CompanyCam to automatically generate Summaries, Daily Logs, Progress Recaps, and Walkthroughs from your job-site Photos

September 1, 2026

Table of contents

[What will each AI feature do?](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/8991633-using-ai-features-for-documents#h_f9abcca274)[Summary](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/8991633-using-ai-features-for-documents#h_45325128d5)[Daily Log](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/8991633-using-ai-features-for-documents#h_19794e5caa)[Progress Recap](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/8991633-using-ai-features-for-documents#h_1ba447221b)[Walkthrough](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/8991633-using-ai-features-for-documents#h_2ab83fb7d5)[On the web](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/8991633-using-ai-features-for-documents#h_cee57f0024)[In the app](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/8991633-using-ai-features-for-documents#h_f51b48ae22)[FAQs](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/8991633-using-ai-features-for-documents#h_1f69782d53)

AI features for Documents let you turn your job site photos into professional updates without writing a single word. Choose from different AI templates: Summary, Daily Log, Progress Recap, and Walkthrough. Select your photos, hit generate, and CompanyCam does the rest.

This feature is available on select plans.

* * *

# What will each AI feature do?

## Summary

Choose a few photos with photo descriptions, get a summary back. No typing required, just instant context for whoever opens the Project next.

## Daily Log

Turn today's photos into today's update, complete with a smart to-do list pulled straight from what still needs to be done. Send it to the office before you're even off site.

## Progress Recap

Your Project's details, an AI-written summary, and your photos organized into a real report. Built for the update you send to a customer or manager who wants the full picture, not just a snapshot.

## Walkthrough

Talk while you walk, snap photos as you go. CompanyCam writes it up and organizes the photos automatically, so you never have to sit down and type it out later.

Important: Summary, Daily Log, Progress Recap, and Walkthrough all contribute to your AI Credit usage.

* * *

# On the web

1. Open a Project and click **Documents**.

2. Click **\+ Document** and select **New Document** in the dropdown.









![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2645171608/7a158ba971e862c7bdfa1a5eecd2/Erich-s+Web+Mockups.png?expires=1794184200&signature=bea9a71747c044f6139eba97afad72540b593c06ece44284fc138eff3228dbb1&req=diYjE8h5nIdfUfMW1HO4zfz9pyCTPURtSd8b%2BLUIuYNKNAFmUmHwoPq2yQ7T%0AZnBp%0A)

3. Choose your AI feature:





   - **Summary** or **Daily Log**: select it directly from the tiles.

   - **Progress Recap**: select **More Templates**, then navigate to **AI Templates** and select **Progress Recap**.


![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2645171006/524e1695d38112b3198c5d291bbf/Untitled+design+-50-.png?expires=1794184200&signature=bfc354fed58580fbbe1ebb4a2388eddb77a2637d741c232a58ed89564d499f84&req=diYjE8h5nIFfX%2FMW1HO4zUcjRpK6aiNvYOcJkue3M6%2BZJ6VM2L2uKi9sgHHp%0AL2KX%0A)

4. Select the photos you'd like to include, then click **Generate**.

5. Once generated, review and make any [edits](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/15880536-editing-pages), if needed.


* * *

# In the app

1. Open a Project and tap **Documents**.

2. Tap the **\+ Icon** and tap **Document**.

3. Choose your AI feature:





   - **Daily Log** or **Walkthrough**: choose it directly from the tiles.

   - **Summary** or **Progress Recap**: choose **More Templates**, then navigate to **AI Templates** and select the one you want.


![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2636403605/fa213eae1eb6a410f79399f6885d/Shayla-s+Mobile+Mockups+-9-.png?expires=1794184200&signature=eac743d2e5b5ccd28de3c80940ae1f849d9ec37d19d021537bea3a5ab810e5b9&req=diYkEM1%2BnodfXPMW1HO4zS%2Fdm%2F0yFh0Q4qECSIwiDrWY4pxXvAUVsEqYuCux%0AH91y76IhK4Ji0cdgagw%3D%0A)

![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2636407764/a9add90303fabae444a53f338d19/Shayla-s+Mobile+Mockups+-10-.png?expires=1794184200&signature=b8df831c0b7d1e59d0a36dbf142fc0a894a47dc478576a8eaeef08d7c2ac117a&req=diYkEM1%2BmoZZXfMW1HO4zaXc27I96P%2BSf0%2FUh6LI8U6PxjLgRsJ8mIkAvNW7%0ApWYMghWXHAZAMraSXaE%3D%0A)

**For Summary, Daily Log, or Progress Recap:**

1. Select the photos you'd like to include, then tap **Generate**.

2. Find your Document in the Documents Tab.


**For Walkthrough:**

1. Tap **Start Walkthrough** to take photos while dictating.

2. Tap **Done** when finished. It saves to the Documents Tab.


![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/big5qq5k/2559991616/04f1495b8b0d3bdbb9a8ba7097fe/Chase-s+Mobile+Mockups+-27-.png?expires=1794184200&signature=f1f00cf1fd180c5af6bda856787ec03a69060d2bb0c1efa107b804725664b2a1&req=diUiH8B3nIdeX%2FMW1HO4zT3u5uGgKgPjjCo7THZdWxtOGGPRC7%2F%2Fx%2FVpfRt9%0As9PqRXzXYoCIF7lSKFM%3D%0A)

Note: Walkthrough is **not** a live video. It is a camera session that records your voice while you capture photos. To optimize your output, use the [recommended best practices](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/12461884-best-practices-when-using-ai-tools-in-companycam) while using this feature.

# FAQs

### Can I create a Walkthrough from my desktop?

No, Walkthroughs can only be created in the mobile app.

### Can AI Features be used in Offline Mode?

AI Features have limited Offline support. The Walkthrough feature is compatible with [Offline Mode](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/6828443-access-offline-mode). If a Project is cached (opened) before going offline, a User can create a new Walkthrough, which will be processed and uploaded once the User regains an internet connection.

The Summary, Daily Log, and Progress Recap features are not compatible with Offline Mode.

### How long can I record a Walkthrough for at a time?

You can record up to 15 minutes per Walkthrough.

### Can I convert a Walkthrough into a Checklist?

Yes, you can convert a Walkthrough into a Checklist. Once your Walkthrough has been saved in your Project, you can convert it to a Checklist by opening the Document > tapping on the **Three-Dots Icon** at the top of the screen > and selecting **Create Checklist**.

### What happens if I generate a Document without enough photo descriptions?

If your photos don't have descriptions to work from, the AI feature still generates a Document, just with an empty state instead of AI-written content. You can add your own text at any time.
